row: 20 Dogs, 3 Dingoes (Wild Canines), 6 Cats + 3 Kids call the farm home here in Australia. Dad, Luke was once in the Military in the Australian Special Forces + Clearance Diver (Aussie equiv. to US Seal) 3 active deployments, was also once a dog daycare owner & a dog trainer. But not anymore. We adopted all our animals during our days of fostering (80+ dogs), except the Pug. We have a few with special needs, some with lifelong behavioural issues & some who are even wild born - who we're trying to help live as close as possible to what they were meant for. We love them all no matter what.
